content: छन्द {%a.%} [छन्द्-अच्] .²1 Pleasing, fascinating, inviting, alluring. .²2 Private, solitary, secret. .²3 Praising. .{@-दः@} {%m.%} .²1 Wish, desire, fancy, liking, will; विज्ञाप्यतां देवी यस्ते छन्द इति <ls>V. 3</ls> just as you like; <ls>Pt. 1. 69</ls>. एते ते मृत्युना ये चिरमनवसिता … श्छन्दं मृगयता <ls>Pratimā 3. 7</ls>. .²2 Free will, oneʼs own choice, whim, free or wilful conduct; षष्ठे काले त्वमपि दिवसस्यात्मनश्छन्दवतीं <ls>V. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 195</ls>; स्वच्छन्दम् according to oneʼs free will, independently. .²3 (Hence) subjection, control. .²4 Meaning, intention, purport. .²5 Poison. .²6 Appearance, look, shape. .²7 Pleasure, delight.
